description: For a first-order structure \(M\) and finite tuple \(\bar a\), \(E(M,\bar a)\) consists of the existential formulas true at that tuple, including quantifier-free formulas with an empty quantifier prefix.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.existentialInformation.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → M) : Set (L.Formula (Fin n))
